meta.name: abp-deployment
meta.description: ABP Framework v10.x (10.4/10.5) deployment: production config, clustered/stateless design, distributed cache (Redis), BLOB provider selection, distributed lock, SignalR backplane, ForwardedHeaders (reverse proxy), SSL/HTTPS, OpenIddict production certificates, Docker/Kubernetes (Helm). Use when you need to deploy an ABP application to production or containerize it.

copy.tagline_en: Automate production deployment and containerization of ABP applications
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to deploy ABP apps to production or containerize them.

howto.what: Claude 会指导你如何正确配置 ABP 框架 v10.x 应用的生产部署，包括集群设计、分布式缓存 (Redis)、BLOB 存储、反向代理、SSL/HTTPS、OpenIddict 证书及 Docker/Kubernetes 等关键设置。
howto.when: 当你提到「ABP deploy」「ABP production」或要求部署/容器化 ABP 应用时触发。

say.text: 帮我部署 ABP 应用到生产环境
say.note: Claude 会给出配置要点和步骤。

say.text: 如何配置 ABP 的分布式缓存和 SignalR 背板？
say.note: Claude 会说明使用 Redis 的方案。

say.text: 生成 ABP 应用的 Docker 和 Kubernetes 配置
say.note: Claude 会参考 etc/ 下的模板给出建议。

howto.what_en: Claude guides you in properly configuring production deployment for ABP Framework v10.x apps, covering cluster design, distributed cache (Redis), BLOB storage, reverse proxy, SSL/HTTPS, OpenIddict certificates, Docker/Kubernetes, and other key settings.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you mention 'ABP deploy', 'ABP production', or ask to deploy/containerize an ABP application.

say_en.text: Help me deploy my ABP application to production.
say_en.note: Claude will provide key steps and best practices.

say_en.text: How to configure distributed cache and SignalR backplane?
Generate Docker and Kubernetes config for my ABP app.
say_en.note: Claude refers to the etc/ template.
